sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM klines ;
SELECT (MAX(open_time_ms) - MIN(open_time_ms)) / (86400000.0 * 365.25) AS value FROM klines ;
SELECT close AS value FROM klines  ORDER BY open_time_ms DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ((arg_max(close, open_time_ms) - arg_min(open, open_time_ms)) / arg_min(open, open_time_ms)) * 100.0 AS value FROM klines ;

SELECT AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dow
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dow
ORDER BY value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN log_ret > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CAST(year(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) AS INTEGER) AS key,
       COUNT(*) AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM klines 
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
SELECT hour AS key, AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT dow AS key, AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow;
SELECT hour AS key, COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(log_ret), 0.0) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT dow AS key, COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(log_ret), 0.0) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow;
SELECT hour AS key, AVG(CASE WHEN log_ret > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT dow AS key, AVG(CASE WHEN log_ret > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow;
SELECT hour AS key, SUM(volume) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT dow AS key, SUM(volume) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow;
SELECT hour AS key, COALESCE(SUM(taker_buy_volume) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0.0), 0.0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT dow AS key, COALESCE(SUM(taker_buy_volume) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0.0), 0.0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow;
SELECT hour AS key, AVG(hl_range) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT dow AS key, AVG(hl_range) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow;

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(dow AS VARCHAR), ':', CAST(hour AS VARCHAR)) AS key, dow, hour, AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dow, hour ORDER BY dow, hour;

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(dow AS VARCHAR), ':', CAST(hour AS VARCHAR)) AS key, dow, hour, COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(log_ret), 0.0) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dow, hour ORDER BY dow, hour;

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(dow AS VARCHAR), ':', CAST(hour AS VARCHAR)) AS key, dow, hour, AVG(CASE WHEN log_ret > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value, COUNT(log_ret) AS n FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dow, hour ORDER BY dow, hour;
SELECT CONCAT(CAST(dow AS VARCHAR), ':', CAST(hour AS VARCHAR)) AS key, dow, hour, SUM(volume) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY dow, hour ORDER BY dow, hour;

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(dow AS VARCHAR), ':', CAST(hour AS VARCHAR)) AS key, dow, hour, COALESCE(SUM(taker_buy_volume) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0.0), 0.0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY dow, hour ORDER BY dow, hour;
SELECT CONCAT(CAST(dow AS VARCHAR), ':', CAST(hour AS VARCHAR)) AS key, dow, hour, AVG(hl_range) * 10000.0 AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM klines  GROUP BY dow, hour ORDER BY dow, hour;

WITH rolled AS (
  SELECT open_time_ms,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY open_time_ms) AS rn,
         COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(log_ret) OVER (ORDER BY open_time_ms ROWS BETWEEN 167 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0.0) * 10000.0 AS value
  FROM klines 
)
SELECT open_time_ms AS timeMs, value
FROM rolled
WHERE rn >= 168
ORDER BY open_time_ms;

WITH rolled AS (
  SELECT open_time_ms,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY open_time_ms) AS rn,
         COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(log_ret) OVER (ORDER BY open_time_ms ROWS BETWEEN 23 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0.0) * 10000.0 AS value
  FROM klines 
)
SELECT open_time_ms AS timeMs, value
FROM rolled
WHERE rn >= 24
ORDER BY open_time_ms;
SELECT AVG(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS value FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(log_ret), 0.0) * 10000.0 AS value FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL;

WITH rets AS (
  SELECT log_ret * 10000.0 AS ret,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log_ret) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL
),
q_ranks AS (
  SELECT ret, rn, cnt,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.01 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p1,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.05 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p5,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.25 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p25,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.50 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p50,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.75 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p75,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.95 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p95,
         LEAST(CAST(floor(0.99 * cnt) AS BIGINT) + 1, cnt) AS r_p99
  FROM rets
)
SELECT 'p1' AS key, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p1 THEN ret END) AS value FROM q_ranks
UNION ALL SELECT 'p5', MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p5 THEN ret END) FROM q_ranks
UNION ALL SELECT 'p25', MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p25 THEN ret END) FROM q_ranks
UNION ALL SELECT 'p50', MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p50 THEN ret END) FROM q_ranks
UNION ALL SELECT 'p75', MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p75 THEN ret END) FROM q_ranks
UNION ALL SELECT 'p95', MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p95 THEN ret END) FROM q_ranks
UNION ALL SELECT 'p99', MAX(CASE WHEN rn = r_p99 THEN ret END) FROM q_ranks;

SELECT COUNT(log_ret) AS n,
       MIN(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS min,
       MAX(log_ret) * 10000.0 AS max
FROM klines WHERE log_ret IS NOT NULL;

SELECT open_time_ms AS timeMs,
       SUM(2.0 * taker_buy_volume - volume) OVER (ORDER BY open_time_ms ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS value
FROM klines 
ORDER BY open_time_ms;

SELECT hour AS key,
       COALESCE(SUM(taker_buy_volume) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0.0), 0.0) * 100.0 AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM klines 
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(year(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) AS VARCHAR), '-', LPAD(CAST(month(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0')) AS key,
       CAST(year(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
       CAST(month(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) - 1 AS INTEGER) AS month,
       ((arg_max(close, open_time_ms) - arg_min(open, open_time_ms)) / arg_min(open, open_time_ms)) * 100.0 AS value
FROM klines 
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY year, month;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT CAST(year(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         CAST(month(epoch_ms(open_time_ms)) AS INTEGER) AS month,
         ((arg_max(close, open_time_ms) - arg_min(open, open_time_ms)) / arg_min(open, open_time_ms)) * 100.0 AS return_pct
  FROM klines 
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT year AS key,
       (PRODUCT(1.0 + (return_pct / 100.0)) - 1.0) * 100.0 AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM monthly
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

WITH hwm AS (
  SELECT open_time_ms,
         close,
         MAX(close) OVER (ORDER BY open_time_ms ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS peak
  FROM klines 
)
SELECT open_time_ms AS timeMs,
       ((close - peak) / peak) * 100.0 AS value
FROM hwm
ORDER BY open_time_ms;
